runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing active items are never removed merely because a new sweep did not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Fresh diversity sweep on 10.9.2026 06:50 across 12 source families. No new promotion-grade unique job. Profesia, company careers, LinkedIn, Worki, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom and Sluzby zamestnanosti were genuinely searched without a new suitable unique delta. Tech/creative sources returned no new suitable non-hard-dev hit. Upwork returned several Worldwide e-commerce/WordPress candidates, including a WooCommerce specialist role at 8–15 USD/h, but it is about four weeks old, has 20–50 proposals and German-language context without a clear language requirement, so it stays verification-only rather than LIVE promotion. Other visible Upwork roles were low-budget, strong-English, development-heavy or workload-heavy. Reddit surfaced US-only hiring and freelancer supply-side posts, not Slovakia-eligible demand. Facebook public indexing produced 0 verified hits; authenticated Nexus ingestion was not started.
